beats.summary: Michael explains the rules of a ring walk challenge involving walking on coals.

evidence.snippet: Michael: What does a great manager need most of all? Courage.

beats.summary: Dwight attempts to walk on coals to prove his worth for the regional manager position.

evidence.snippet: Dwight (walking on coals): I will walk and stand on these coals until you award me the position of regional manager!
Dwight (falling on his knees, then on all fours): Aaagh, aaagh!

beats.summary: Andy tries to get attention by pretending to float away in water.

evidence.snippet: Andy (Trying to wet bandana, falls in water): Oh, God! Waaa! Guhh! Wuuuh! Help! Angela! Angela, hey! Oh, thank God! Please tell somebody!
Andy: Go tell them I'm floating away, obviously!

beats.summary: Michael reflects on the difficulty of finding a suitable successor.

evidence.snippet: Michael: I knew that finding a successor would be difficult. I did not know that it would be impossible.

beats.summary: Jim and Karen have a humorous miscommunication about a job in 'well'.

evidence.snippet: Jim: How would that work in well? I just want to know.

beats.summary: Stanley expresses frustration and decides to sit in the bus, indicating a break from the activity.

evidence.snippet: Stanley: Uh, we don't have any safety mittens
